description: This Dart source file defines the TasksPage widget, a stateful widget responsible for displaying a list of tasks with filtering options, real-time stream updates from a task repository, and navigation to task creation and editing pages. It also includes UI components for filtering tasks by status, project, and tags, and rendering each task with detailed metadata.

classes.name: TasksPage
classes.description: The main page widget displaying a list of tasks with filtering options and navigation controls.

classes.name: _TasksPageState
classes.description: The widget state managing tasks list, filters, and interactions.

classes.name: _TaskListTile
classes.description: A stateless widget representing each task item in the list with UI details and interactions.

classes.name: _StatusFilterChip
classes.description: A dropdown widget for selecting task status filter.

classes.name: _ProjectDropdown
classes.description: A dropdown widget for selecting a project filter, fed from project repository stream.

classes.name: _TagDropdown
classes.description: A dropdown widget for selecting a tag filter, fed from tag repository stream.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the main widget tree for the page, including filter buttons and task list stream.

methods.name: _buildFilters
methods.description: Constructs the UI for task filters: status, project, tag, and clear filters.

methods.name: _buildStreamList
methods.description: Creates a StreamBuilder for live task list updates and handles empty states.

methods.name: _matchesFilters
methods.description: Checks if a task matches current filter criteria.

methods.name: _toggleDone
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of a task and updates it via repository.

methods.name: _openCreate
methods.description: Navigates to the task creation page.

methods.name: _openEdit
methods.description: Navigates to the task editing page for a specific task.
